toneDescription: Curious, slightly wry science-communicator voice. Leans into the 'what if' framing rather than presenting speculation as settled fact. Short punchy sentences for hooks; a bit more measured for LinkedIn.
examplePosts: Every 'sci-fi cliché' started as someone's serious research proposal. Today's is brain-wave decoding.
We've been able to watch neurons fire for decades. We still can't agree on what that activity actually *is*.
